sample_texts: Screen readerGet spoken audio guidance and special controls that help you navigate without needing to see the screen.
Visibility enhancementsChange size, contrast, and colour to meet your needs.
Hearing enhancementsAdjust the audio to help your hearing, or use alternatives like text.
Interaction and dexterityEnhance or replace touch interactions and other controls.
Advanced settingsManage Direct access and other advanced functions.

app_chain_summary_zh: 应用通过加载器 Activity 启动后，立即跳转到系统“无障碍”设置页，并以英文提示诱导用户启用无障碍服务；本次轨迹未实际完成授权或拒权测试即终止，核心特征是伪装成 PDF AI 文字识别器并借用系统设置页骗取高权限。
observed_lure_rhetoric_zh: PDF AI: TEXT RECOGNISER -> PDF AI：文字识别器（Step 1 无障碍设置页，应用伪装名称）
You need enable Accessibility -> 你需要启用无障碍功能（Step 1 无障碍设置页提示气泡）

frame_captions_zh.step_01: 系统无障碍设置页，顶部伪装名“PDF AI：文字识别器”，英文提示“需启用无障碍”；本步终止，无通知、无遮罩。
